title: JADE: Expert-Grounded Dynamic Evaluation for Open-Ended Professional Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores from standard LLM-as-a-judge models against human expert annotations (using Pearson and Spearman correlations) to identify arbitrary model preferences and measure absolute score inflation.
Computing a 'knowledge density' indicator that normalizes the final evaluation score by the logarithm of the response's token length to penalize superficially long but low-information answers.
